enabled.title: Turn on universal cross-platform polls
enabled.description: Uses the existing main platform intake actions and announces one shared poll to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok. No separate poll trigger is needed.

commandPrefix.title: Command prefix
commandPrefix.description: One visible character placed before poll and vote, such as ! or ?.

pollCommand.title: Poll management command name
pollCommand.description: Enter the word without !. Moderators and the broadcaster use this command.

voteCommand.title: Viewer vote command name
voteCommand.description: Enter the word without !. The default lets viewers vote with !vote 1.

closePollOnStreamEnd.title: Close the poll when every platform is offline
closePollOnStreamEnd.description: Prevents an old poll from remaining open for the next stream.

maximumPollOptions.title: Choices allowed in one poll
maximumPollOptions.description: Six is recommended so the question remains readable in chat and on the result card.
